name: Frikadeller (Danish Meatballs)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 20% by volume (about ¾ cup) of bread crumbs

steps: Mix all ingredients except butter together.
Fry in hot skillet with lots of butter.

culture.text: A Frikadelle is a rounded, flat-bottomed, pan-fried meatball of ground meat, often likened to the German version of meatballs. The origin of the dish is unknown. The term Frikadelle is German, but the dish is associated with German, Nordic, and Eastern European cuisines. They are one of the most popular meals in Poland, where they are known as kotlety mielone or regionally sznycle ("schnitzels").
